# Introduction
Below is a brief checklist summarising the steps you should take when developing your DataSHIELD package.

## Checklist for developing new functions
- [ ] Install R & RStudio  
- [ ] Install additional R development packages  
- [ ] Create Github repositories  
- [ ] Initialise new R packages and link with Github  
- [ ] Write initial documentation  
- [ ] Write client-side function(s)
- [ ] Write server-side function(s)
- [ ] Add server-side function(s) to DataSHIELD exports file  
- [ ] Try functions using DSLite  
- [ ] Run `devtools::check()`
- [ ] Set up test environment  
- [ ] Write server-side unit tests  
- [ ] Write client-side unit tests  
- [ ] Write vignettes  
- [ ] Run `devtools::check()` again
- [ ] Build Github site (Optional)  
- [ ] Create a Github release  
- [ ] Submit package to CRAN (Optional)
